Name: WEATHER_ASSET_REPLACE_PARAM_ST
Description: Weather-dependent assets in sky maps. When a map with rows here loads, each of its assets whose model is listed in a row is shown only while the current weather (and asset limit ID) matches one of the rows listing it; other assets are unaffected. Retail row ID = AA × 100000 + DD × 1000 + (ashen state + 1) × 100 + weather.

Fields.Name: Map ID
Fields.Description: The sky map as 8 digits AABBCCDD (e.g. 10000099 for m10_00_00_99). Only rows with DD 99 are loaded (98 instead in an alternate game state); open-world rows need BB and CC 00 (60000099, 61000099).

Fields.Name: Weather
Fields.Description: The weather (WeatherParam row ID) in which this row's assets are shown.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Ashen State Condition
Fields.Description: 0: row applies only before the ashen state. 1: only during it (retail Leyndell, Ashen Capital rows). 2: always.
Padding.

Fields.Name: reserved2
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (0 in retail).

Fields.Name: Asset ID [0]
Fields.Description: Asset model shown in this weather (AEG999_999 -> 999999), matched against the map's asset parts. -1: none.
